scope: Synthetic witnesses only; no game execution

dispatch_boundary.interpretation: Both frames admit the same record, because pump uses previous published delta. The existing, unpaused timer, set to 1 by an admitted action before stage 4, then sees different current delta. Record timestamp and record order alone cannot select the post-tick remaining value.

equal_total_float32.interpretation: Even an exact known summed delta does not encode the number and partition of float32 stores. Tiny dyadic values deliberately isolate rounding, not typical frame timing.
